_comment: Minimal golden set for P1 Stages 1-2 (decision 3 of projects/vaultrag/p1-step-plan.md). Hand-written (query -> expected vault-relative path) pairs over the vaultrag-design vault, a forward-compatible subset of projects/vaultrag/evaluation-framework.md (the full 50-150 pair set + CI gate is P2). Run manually via `uv run python -m tests.eval.run_eval` before/after a retrieval change; NOT a pytest/CI gate (needs live Qdrant + Ollama + the reranker model).

cases.query: why did we choose Qdrant as the vector store
why BM25 sparse vectors in Qdrant instead of Elasticsearch
why heading-tree chunking instead of fixed-size chunks
which dense embedding model do we use and why Qwen3
why is the reranker bge-reranker-v2-m3
why return snippets instead of synthesized answers by default
why MCP-first instead of REST-first
why in-process asyncio jobs instead of Redis or Celery
why payload partitioning for tenants instead of a collection per project
why not full GraphRAG
how does hybrid search fuse dense and sparse results with RRF
what are the stages of the retrieval pipeline and their latency budget
how does the cross-encoder reranking stage work, top-50 to top-8
how are token budget and context compression handled, MMR and near-dupe drop
write-back safety, base_hash lock, git auto-commit and agent-inbox
the ingestion pipeline watchdog debounce and manifest diff for renames
the Qdrant payload metadata schema fields for a chunk
the MCP tool signatures for search and open
the security model, tenancy enforcement and secret redaction
the SQLite database schema for documents chunks links and jobs
